content: No, that is not accurate. In Switzerland, the rules for terminating a rental apartment are governed by the federal law known as the Tenancy Act (Mietrecht) and can vary depending on the canton and specific rental agreement. Generally, the notice period for terminating a rental agreement is typically three months, not one month. However, there are exceptions and special cases, such as when both parties agree to terminate the contract early or when the tenant is moving due to specific circumstances (e.g., job relocation). It is also important to note that terminating a rental agreement via email alone may not be sufficient; the termination must be in writing and follow the proper legal procedures as outlined in the rental agreement and applicable laws. It is always advisable to consult with a legal professional or a tenant's association for specific guidance on your situation.
